paragraphs.text: A project knowledge base for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: notes, media sandbox, canvas, mind graph,
board and project mirroring.
# dsh-scriptorium

Scriptorium is a project knowledge base inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: workspaces bound to
Har
ness projects, nested documents, a Markdown editor with live preview, full-text search, a command pa

lette, a
kanban board, a free-form media canvas, an Obsidian-style mind graph, tags, favourites, tra

sh and
ZIP/JSON archives — all stored in one JSON file on the host that this plugin owns.
The panel lives in the sidebar (book icon, "Scriptorium"). Everything else is one keystroke away.
## What it looks like
| **Documents** — nested notes, split editor and a live preview, tags and status in the header. | **
Media sandbox** — every screenshot, PDF and clip in the project, filterable by kind. |
| **Canvas** — attachments become cards beside the note that owns them, joined by an edge. | **Mind
graph** — notes are nodes, `[[wiki links]]` are edges; opens fitted to the panel. |
| **Board** — Draft / Active / Done, straight from each note's status. | **Command palette** — `Ctrl
+K`, every action one fuzzy query away. |
**In practice:**

- A design review: drop three screenshots on the note, arrange them on the canvas next to the
brief,

link them, and the graph shows which notes reference which.
- A release: every note carries a statu

s, so the board is the plan — drag a card and the note's
status changes on disk.
- A month later: `C

trl+K` or search finds the note, the graph shows its neighbours, and the
attachment is still next to
the paragraph it explains.
## What you get
| Area | Behaviour |
| Organize | Workspaces → folders → nested documents, drag a document onto a folder, inline rename,

reorder |
| Projects | Every notebook mirrors one Harness project from `<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspac
e.json`: the sidebar lists each project with its path and accent dot, sync creates/renames notebooks
, a vanished project is flagged `missing` (its documents are kept), and an unlinked notebook can be

linked — or merged into the existing project notebook |
| Write | Markdown editor: headings, **bold*
*, *italic*, ~~strike~~, `code`, links, images, tables, task lists, `::: note/tip/warning/danger` ca

llouts, fenced code with a copy button, `$math$`, horizontal rules |
| Preview | Write / split / pre

view modes, task checkboxes toggle the source line, scroll sync |
| Find | `Ctrl+K` command palette
(fuzzy, recency-aware) and full-text search with highlighted title/body matches and relevance rankin

g |
| Track | Kanban board with Draft / Active / Done columns; drag a card to change its status |
|
Classify | Tags on every document, tag cloud filtering, generated per-tag colours, a per-tag view |

| Keep | Favourites, soft trash with restore, permanent purge, empty trash |
| Attachments | Upload
images, PDF, audio, video and text files per document; in-app preview modal (PDF via the browser vie

wer); media sandbox view with kind filters |
| Canvas | Free-form media canvas: every attachment bec
omes a draggable, resizable card beside the document that owns it, joined by an edge; pan, wheel/but

ton zoom, fit-to-screen, link two cards, keyboard nudging, delete a link |
| Connections | Obsidian-
style mind graph: notes are nodes, `[[wiki links]]` (with `|alias` and `#heading`) and optional tags
are edges; animated force layout, drag nodes, pan/zoom, search dimming, neighbour highlighting, cli

ck to open, "connect two notes" writes the link into the source note |
| Portability | Export JSON,
export ZIP (manifest + Markdown notes + media bytes), import JSON (merged, never overwriting) and im
port ZIP (ids remapped, media stored); the canvas travels both ways and is re-pointed at the importe

mapped, media stored); the canvas travels both ways and is re-pointed at the imported ids |
[该节后续省略]
## Storage

- Documents: `<DSH_HOME>/scriptorium/data.json` (atomic tmp+rename writes, one serialized queue,
rev

ision counter; oversized or malformed snapshots are rejected with a 400).
- Snapshots are validated

field by field before `POST /save` or a ZIP import can persist them:
workspace ids are unique, every

node belongs to an existing workspace, parent chains resolve and
stay inside one workspace without

cycles, tags are non-empty strings, attachment ids are unique
and resolvable, canvas cards point at

live nodes/attachments with canonical ids, canvas links
connect existing cards, and graph preference

s are the three known booleans. Errors name the
exact path (for example `nodes[12].media[0].id`) and

nothing is written when validation fails.
A snapshot newer than this build's `STORE_VERSION` is rej

ected with a clear message; older
versions run the ordered migrations first. Unknown top-level block

s are still carried through.
- Attachments: `<DSH_HOME>/scriptorium/media/<id>` plus a `<id>.json` s

idecar with name/mime/size.
`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`. A directory left by the pre-rename buil

d (`<DSH_HOME>/alexandrie/`)
is moved into place on first mount, so existing notes, attachments and

layout survive the rename.
- Layout copy: `<DSH_HOME>/scriptorium/layout.json` holds only `canvas` +

`graph` and is written
before `data.json` on every save. A pre-canvas build rebuilds `data.json` fr

om a fixed key list
and never touches this file, so a downgrade cannot destroy the board: the next l

oad merges the
layout back (cards whose document was deleted meanwhile are pruned), and the read its

elf never
rewrites `data.json`.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility and permissions

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web profile; the client half declares `platform: "web"` and injects
only

the `slots` service. The host half injects `webServer` and registers routes under
`/dsh-scriptorium

`.
- Node.js `>=22` (the host half is dependency-free ESM).
- No outbound network calls, no telemetr

y, no third-party embeds.
- Writes only under `<DSH_HOME>/scriptorium/` (`data.json`, `layout.json`,

`media/`). Reads
`<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json` read-only to mirror the Harness project list.
- Caps: 12 MB per attachment, 24 MB per snapshot.
## Limitations

- The GUI shell answers `401` to plain HTTP without a browser session, so visual end-to-end
checking

is manual: the automated evidence is the component tree, the host route suite and the
slot-registra

tion check (`main` key + `sidebar.panellist` row).
- Media previews depend on the browser: PDFs use

the built-in viewer, office documents fall back
to a download link.
- Attachments are capped at 12 M
B each; the whole snapshot at 24 MB.
